plugins.name: no-co-authored
plugins.description: Blocks git commits whose message carries a Co-Authored-By trailer or the Claude Code footer, asking Claude to recreate the message without them.

plugins.name: git-sign-key
plugins.description: Signs git commits with a ~/.claude/sign.key file via SSH signing instead of the ssh-agent.

plugins.name: branch-management
plugins.description: Branch lifecycle skills. new-branch cuts a fresh branch inline; new-pr runs iterative parallel review rounds (claude/codex/copilot/coderabbit reviewers) backed by subagents, applies verified fixes between rounds, opens a PR/MR via gh or glab, and watches CI until green.

plugins.name: superpowers-automation
plugins.description: A new-work pipeline orchestrator that classifies a description as feature/fix/refactor and runs the matching flow (feature/refactor: branch -> brainstorm -> review -> plan -> review -> implement; fix: systematic-debugging), plus the file-advisor-improver reviser and an opt-in plan hook forcing Subagent-Driven implementation.

plugins.name: claude-code-knowledge
plugins.description: Lookup skill plus harness-optimized reference files for authoring and configuring Claude Code — skills, subagents, hooks, slash commands, MCP, plugins, CLAUDE.md memory, and settings — plus a read-only expert agent that replaces the built-in claude-code-guide. Retrieves only the relevant section into context.

plugins.name: coding-toolbox
plugins.description: Mechanically enforces the Interaction axis on Stop and blocks non-UTF-8 file operations; the golden behavior rules doc is available as an opt-in project rule via the setup-rules skill.

plugins.name: universal-format
plugins.description: Silently auto-formats just-written Shell/Java/Kotlin/JS-TS/Python/Go files after Write/Edit via each language's standard formatter (no-op when absent), honoring .editorconfig and tool-native configs.

plugins.name: universal-lint
plugins.description: Silently runs each language's standard linter (read-only — never autofixes) on just-written Shell/Java/Kotlin/JS-TS/Python/Go files after Write/Edit, surfacing findings as context for Claude to fix (shellcheck, checkstyle, ktlint, eslint, ruff check, golangci-lint/go vet).

plugins.name: memory-enhancement
plugins.description: A dream skill that runs a natural-language-triggered, four-phase memory-consolidation cycle over this project's auto-memory files (orient, gather signal from recent session transcripts, consolidate merging duplicates/dropping stale entries/resolving contradictions, update the MEMORY.md index under its 200-line load cutoff), compressing touched detail files caveman-style via claude-code-knowledge's cc-compress; a Stop/SessionStart hook pair flags and nudges the next session to run one, gated by the auto_dream toggle (default true).
